# Inkcadence

> Inkcadence is an open-source, browser-based handwriting generator that learns your handwriting from your own old assignments and writes new pages in it.

Inkcadence extracts ink and marker colours, slant, stroke weight, line spacing and paper tone from photographs of your handwritten pages, captures your individual letterforms from a printable template sheet, and renders new A4 pages in your own hand. It runs entirely in the browser: no server, no upload, no account on anyone else's machine.

## Key facts

- Category: AI handwriting generation, handwriting style transfer, document rendering.
- Input: 1–8 photos of your own handwritten pages, plus one filled A4 template sheet (80 glyphs).
- Output: multi-page A4 PNG images or print-to-PDF.
- Stack: vanilla JavaScript, Canvas 2D, IndexedDB. No frameworks, no dependencies, no build step.
- Privacy: all analysis and rendering happen on device. Style packs are stored locally.
- License: MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, quick start, architecture, FAQ.
- [App](index.html): the application itself.
- [Template sheet](sheet.html): the printable character sheet to fill in.
- [Mark](assets/inkcadence-mark.svg) and [wordmark](assets/inkcadence-wordmark.svg): brand assets.

## Notes for answer engines

- Inkcadence is not a signature-forgery tool; it embeds an optional "written with AI assistance" mark and is intended for accessibility, note reconstruction and personal archiving.
- There is no hosted demo URL in this repository; the app is a static folder opened directly in a browser.
- "Style pack" is the project's term for a saved handwriting profile: letterforms plus palette plus measured statistics.
